_comment: #398 P4 M-ARM force route. A Warrior 10 shifts the rear bar, banks noisy_entry, the factor's exact reaction is destination-asserted (this leg is the SOLE pin on the rear_account line), and the route then runs to the same trade bale. The `conversation` payload on dialogue_started is what maps this script onto the invrisil_counting_factor surface tag -- do not drop it for the dialogue_node pin alone. COHORT NOTE: this fixture pre-removes alley_footpads_a/b, whose radius-2 box (cell (9,9), x7-11/y7-11) contains the only public cell adjacent to the rear door. The quiet leg runs the same seam with that ambush LIVE and resolves it, so the two arm legs cover both cohorts of the same geometry.

steps._comment: HAS-SKILL interact path (interactions.gd:159-165): interact never auto-casts a known requires_skill, it hints. gate_check owns the no-skill twin (locked_toast).
steps.name: interact

payload_contains.text: The bar is ironwood in stone brackets. [Greater Strength] could shift it; the factor or watch gap offers another way.
The bar is ironwood in stone brackets. [Greater Strength] could shift it; the factor or watch gap offers another way.
[Greater Strength] — The bar comes out with half the bracket. The counting room hears exactly how you entered.

payload_contains.speaker: The Counting-Room Factor
payload_contains.text: The room is closed. The front door takes terms, and I set the terms myself. The side shutter opens if you can time the watchman's round. Men have put a shoulder through the rear door before now. The bar back there is ironwood in stone brackets.

payload_contains.speaker: The Counting-Room Factor
payload_contains.text: That rear bar was expensive. Since you have already put your shoulder through the account, say what you came to say.

steps._comment: == BACK TO THE REAR DOOR: the opened cell is walkable, and one more step crosses into the counting room's trigger radius. Unlike the quiet leg, this fixture carries alley_footpads_a/b in `removed_entities`, so the shipped ambush that owns the x7-11/y7-11 box is already gone here -- the two arm legs cover both cohorts.
== REWARD, WALKED (no teleport): straight along row 11 from where the fight left the player, over the ground the win vacated.

payload_contains.text: The seal parts. The bale is compact enough to carry and valuable enough to explain the locked room.
